responsibility: This machine-description fragment implements the AArch64 SME and SME2 RTL patterns that are separate from the base SVE file. It defines instruction patterns, UNSPEC codes, and state-management operations for streaming mode and ZA/SM state, plus SME loads, stores, moves, zeroing, ZA-slice arithmetic, matrix and outer-product operations, and LUT instructions, giving the backend and SME builtin expander the RTL-to-assembly mapping needed for streaming-mode code generation and ZA/ZT0 manipulation.
